title: A proteomics protocol to identify stimulation-induced binding partners dependent on a specific gene in mammalian cells
protocol: Remove old medium from MAVS+/+ and MAVS−/− HEK293T cells (with 80–90% confluency) and mildly wash cells once by PBS.
Add 2 mL trypsin to each 10-cm dish, place the dishes in a cell culture incubator for 5 min at 37°C.
Add 4 mL warm (37°C) DMEM medium into each plate to inactivate trypsin.
Pipette the cells softly and then transfer the suspension into 15-mL tubes and spin at 600 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant, add 6 mL fresh medium to each tube, and then suspend the cells by pipetting.
Prepare two 10-cm dishes and add 2 mL of MAVS+/+ HEK293T cells and 8 mL fresh DMEM medium into each plate.
Similarly, add 2 mL of MAVS−/− HEK293T cells and 8 mL fresh DMEM medium into a new plate.
Pipette the medium to homogenize cells (∼30% confluency), and put into an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
After seeded for 16 h, the cells will reach about 70%-80% confluency.
Dilute Lipofectamine 2000 with 100 μL Opti-MEM.
Dilute 10 μg Flag-PRMT7 with 100 μL Opti-MEM.
After 5-min incubation, mix them gently and incubate for 20 min at room temperature.
Add DNA-Lipofectamine 2000 complexes (100 μL) to each dish.
Mix gently by rocking the plate back and forth.
Change the medium with fresh pre-warmed medium after 6 hours.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 10 hours before SeV stimulation.
Stimulate MAVS+/+ and MAVS−/− HEK293T cells with or without SeV for 8 hours.
Dilute SeV (MOI=1) in minimal volume of serum-free medium.
Add diluted SeV to MAVS+/+ and MAVS−/− HEK293T cells.
Add serum-free medium to another set of MAVS+/+ HEK293T cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 8 h.
Remove the medium from the transfected cells.
Wash dishes twice with 10 mL PBS.
For each dish, add 1 mL lysis buffer (RIPA).
Shake on a horizontal shaker at 4°C for 30 min.
Use cell scrapers to lift cells if multiple dishes are transfected with the same plasmid.
Transfer cell lysate into 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant into new microcentrifuge tubes.
Measure protein concentration using BCA assay or other available methods.
Add additional lysis buffer (RIPA) to ensure the same concentration for different samples.
Save 50 μL of each lysate as input and store at -80°C.
Keep agarose beads on ice and slowly warm them at 4°C for 5 min.
Gently rotate to mix bead slurry.
Add 20 μL anti-Flag M2 agarose bead slurry into each tube.
Wash beads with 1 ml lysis buffer by gently resuspending.
Centrifuge at 5000 × g for 1 min at 4°C, and remove supernatant.
Repeat washing three times.
Replace 1 ml cell lysates from step 10 to each tube containing washed beads.
Put tubes on an end-over-end rotator at 4°C for 3 h or overnight.
Be careful not to transfer any resin when removing the supernatant.
Use a narrow-end pipette tip made by pinching the opening of a plastic pipette tip with forceps.
Centrifuge tubes containing lysate and beads at 5000 × g for 1 minute at 4°C, then remove the supernatant.
Wash beads with 1 mL lysis buffer to resuspend gently and remove nonspecific binding proteins.
Centrifuge at 5000 × g for 1 minute at 1°C, then remove the supernatant.
Repeat washing and centrifuging steps three times.
Add 50 μL of 2 × SDS sample buffer to each sample.
Boil samples for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples at 5000 × g for 2 minutes at 4°C, then transfer supernatants to new 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Keep on ice or store at -80°C until use.
Load inputs and concentrated samples on SDS-PAGE gel in duplicate.
Use one set of gels for silver staining or Coomassie blue staining.
Transfer another set of gels to PVDF membrane for Western blot analysis.
Incubate the membranes with anti-Flag antibody.
Perform immunoblotting analysis of inputs from wildtype and knockout cells.
Separate proteins by SDS-PAGE after validation of affinity purified proteins.
Digest proteins into small peptides using in-gel digestion for mass spectrometry analysis.
Excise Coomassie blue stained bands.
Separate protein samples by SDS-PAGE using straight percentage gels (10%–12%).
Load each sample into two adjacent wells, up to 20 μL per well.
Run the gel until samples reach 1.0–1.5 cm in length at 200V for approximately 10 minutes.
Stain the gels with Coomassie blue.
Scan the stained gel before cutting out bands.
Excise bands of each sample from the gel, cutting into 5-12 slices per lane.
Cut excised slices further into 1.0 × 1.0 mm pieces and place them in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Wash gel pieces with 300 μL dH2O for 15 minutes.
Add 300 μL CH3CN to wash gel pieces for 15 minutes, then remove supernatant.
Wash gel pieces with 300 μL NH4HCO3 (100 mM) for 15 minutes and discard supernatant.
Dehydrate gel pieces by adding 100 μL CH3CN and incubating for 5 minutes until they shrink and turn white.
Dry the gel pieces in a speedvac for 5 minutes.
Reduce gel pieces by adding 50 μL DTT (10 mM) in 100 mM NH4HCO3 to each sample and incubate at 56°C for 1 hour.
Discard supernatant after reduction step.
Alkylation of gel pieces: Add 50 μL of freshly prepared iodoacetamide in 50 mM NH4HCO3 (pH 8.5) to each sample, and incubate in dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Discard supernatant after alkylation step.
Wash band pieces with 300 μL of 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 15 min.
Remove supernatant.
Wash band pieces with 300 μL of 20 mM NH4HCO3/CH3CN (50:50 V/V) for 15 min.
Remove supernatant.
Add 100 μL CH3CN to dehydrate band pieces for 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Dry band pieces in a speedvac for 5 min.
Add 20 μL of 12.5 μg/mL trypsin in 20 mM NH4HCO3 to each sample.
Incubate at 37°C overnight.
Transfer supernatants to new 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Add 50 μL of 1% formic acid to each sample and incubate for 20 min.
Transfer supernatant to corresponding tubes from step (a).
Repeat steps (a) and (b) one more time.
Add 150 μL CH3CN to each sample and incubate for 10 min.
Transfer supernatant to corresponding tubes from step (a).
Use a speedvac to dry peptides in tubes from step (a) completely.
Resuspend invisible pellet with 50 μL of 1% formic acid.
Firstly add 10 μL of 5% formic acid, then add 40 μL dH2O to optimize solubilization of peptides.
Store at -20°C or -80°C.
Dissolve tryptic peptides in 0.1% formic acid (solvent A).
Load the dissolved peptides directly into a reversed-phase analytical column.
Apply a gradient from 5% to 6% solvent B over 5.2 min, followed by an increase to 33% in 52.8 min and then climbing to 90%, holding at 90% for 6.8 min.
Maintain a constant flow rate of 400 nL/min during the gradient application.
Subject peptides to electrospray ionization (ESI).
Conduct tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) using Q ExactiveTM HF-X coupled online to UPLC.
Set the electrospray voltage applied to 2.4 kV.
Use an m/z scan range of 350–1800 for full scans.
Detect intact peptides in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 60,000.
Select peptides for MS/MS using NCE setting as 28.
Detect fragments in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 15,000.
Use a data-dependent procedure that alternates between one full scan followed by 25 MS/MS scans with dynamic exclusion for 25.0 s.
Set fixed first mass as 100 m/z.
Process raw data with pFind (V3.1.6) software.
Search peak lists against NCBI protein database.
Allow four missed cleavages for trypsin.
Set precursor ion mass tolerance at 20 ppm.
Set fragment ion mass tolerance at 20 ppm.
Set minimum peptide length to 6 amino acids.
Specify estimated false discovery rate (FDR) threshold for peptides and proteins at maximum 1%.
Identify PRMT7-associated proteins in each sample after analysis.
Compare identified proteins from different samples.
Consider proteins enriched in sample B compared to A as virus-induced PRMT7 associated proteins.
Consider proteins diminished in sample C compared with B as PRMT7 associated proteins dependent on MAVS.
Determine common proteins from the comparisons [(B-A)∩(B-C)] as virus-induced PRMT7 associated proteins dependent on MAVS.
Treat 80%-90% confluent MAVS+/+ HEK293T cells (four 10-cm dishes including one as control) and MAVS−/− HEK293T cells (three 10-cm dishes) with SeV for 0 h, 4 h, and 8 h.
Preclear cell lysate by combining with 20 μL Protein A/G and 1 μg IgG in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate tubes at 4°C with gentle rotation for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 5000 × g for 1 min at 4°C, and remove supernatant to new 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes placed on ice.
Add appropriate amount of PRMT7 antibody to precleared lysates.
Incubate samples at 4°C for 2 hours with gentle rotation.
Add 20 μL Protein A/G to each sample.
Incubate samples at 4°C for 4 hours or overnight with gentle rotation.
Wash and elute affinity purified proteins following the protocol steps from 17 to 23.
Load and run inputs and concentrated samples on SDS-PAGE gels.
Transfer gels to PVDF membranes.
Use indicated antibodies for Western blot analysis.
